story.iWant: export my edited timeline as an MP4 file
story.soThat: I can share my video or upload it to platforms
story.tasks: - Create FFmpeg service for export operations (main process) - Implement FFmpeg progress parsing - Create IPC handlers for export operations (start-export, export-progress, export-complete, export-error) - Create ExportModal component (resolution picker, file location) - Create ExportProgress component (progress bar, success/error notifications) - Integrate Export button in TopBar - Implement FFmpeg command building logic (concat, trim, resolution scaling) - Handle export errors gracefully - Add export state management to uiStore - Test export functionality end-to-end

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: AC1: Export button in top bar becomes enabled when timeline has clips AC2: Clicking Export opens export dialog with settings (720p, 1080p, Source quality, output file location) AC3: Export process starts and displays progress bar with percentage AC4: FFmpeg processes timeline clips in sequence with proper encoding AC5: Exported MP4 file plays correctly in external player (QuickTime, VLC) AC6: Audio and video remain synchronized in exported file AC7: Export completes without memory leaks or crashes AC8: User receives success notification with file location

docs.doc: FFmpeg export processes timeline clips to MP4. Resolution options: 720p, 1080p, source. Progress updates sent via IPC (max 10Hz). Export runs in main process (child_process.spawn). Renderer shows progress bar. Must complete without memory leaks.

ffmpeg.service.ts implements export pipeline: command building, child process execution, progress parsing. IPC handlers in ffmpeg.handlers.ts bridge renderer export requests to main process FFmpeg execution. Export options include clips array, resolution, output path.

User clicks Export → ExportModal opens → User selects resolution and output path → start-export IPC sent → Main process builds FFmpeg command → FFmpeg processes clips → Progress events sent to renderer → On complete: export-complete event → Success notification shown.

Main process handles FFmpeg/File I/O. Renderer handles UI. IPC channels: start-export (request), export-progress (event), export-complete (event), export-error (event). Prevents UI freezing during long operations.
Use ffmpeg-static package (version 5.2.0, FFmpeg 6.0). Bundles FFmpeg binaries with app, no external dependencies. Execute via child_process.spawn in main process. Parse progress from stderr.
FR016: Export edited timeline to MP4 format using FFmpeg. FR017: Provide resolution options (720p, 1080p, source quality). FR018: Display real-time export progress indicator with percentage complete.

constraints.constraint: Main/renderer separation: FFmpeg runs ONLY in main process (ADR-002). Export commands sent via IPC. Progress events sent back to renderer.
FFmpeg command injection prevention: Use argument array (not shell string concatenation). Validate output paths to prevent arbitrary file system writes.
Progress updates sent at maximum 10Hz (every 100ms) to avoid IPC flooding. Export runs asynchronously, main window remains responsive.
Export failures must be caught and reported to user with actionable messages. No partial/corrupted MP4 files left on error. FFmpeg stderr captured and logged.
Use libx264 codec for video, aac for audio. Preset: fast (balance between speed and quality). Audio bitrate: 192k.
